lines.369680624357289985: Don’t let him get to Eddie first. If he does, our deal is off.
lines.369680624357289986: Who is he? Is he looking for Eddie too?
lines.369680624361484288: Probably just some asshole trying to make a quick buck. I’m sure you can handle him.
lines.369680624361484289: I don’t know. I’m not doing too great…
lines.369680624361484290: You’re not thinking of quitting on me, are you?
lines.369680624361484291: What’s so important about Eddie Velvet anyway?
lines.369680624365678593: Yeah? What are you going to do about it? What if I just get the hell out of here and disappear?
lines.369680624369872896: You begged me for this assignment, remember?
lines.369680624369872897: I'm doing you a favor here. And you're talking about backing out?
lines.369680624374067200: We have a deal, Walker. You will uphold your end of the bargain. Is that clear?
lines.369680624374067201: I’m sorry. I’m sorry Mr. Jackman.
lines.369680624374067202: Do what you need to do to see this through. We won’t talk about this again. I’ll be in touch.
lines.369680624378261504: I shot him. The old guy.
lines.369680624378261505: Easy now. Tell me what happened.
lines.369680624378261506: He was choking me. Like he was trying to kill me. I got a hold of his gun.
lines.369680624378261507: Don't worry about it. No one will find out.
lines.369680624382455808: There was something he said, he was talking about Eddie... I can't put my finger on it.
lines.369680624382455809: Don't dwell on it. You'll have time to brood all you want once you've got a hold of Eddie for me.
lines.369680624382455810: You acted in self defense, a man is dead, case closed. Any doubts or questions that you have are only going to slow you down.
lines.369680624382455811: I'll try to let it go.
lines.369680624386650112: Good man. You did the right thing. Be careful out there.
lines.369680624390844416: Walker. I know you’ve gone through a lot to get here.
lines.369680624390844417: I just want to wrap this up and go home.
lines.369680624390844418: I understand. You’ll have earned it. Listen. I need you to push ahead. I’m not gonna sugar coat this, so I’ll just say it.
lines.369680624395038720: Eddie is not leaving Silver Pines.
lines.369680624395038721: He’s not? I thought that was the whole point. I find him and then I bring him back.
lines.369680624395038722: When you find him, and I know you will, I need you to put an end to him. Finish him off.
lines.369680624395038723: You want me to kill him.
lines.369680624399233024: Don’t act surprised. You knew this was coming. Killing Eddie is your ticket out of there, detective. There’s no other way.
lines.369680624399233025: I'm a private investigator, mr Jackman. Not an assassin.
lines.369680624403427328: I think we both know that's not quite true, after everything that's happened.
lines.369680624403427329: You’re in the deep end, Walker. You sink or you swim.
lines.369680624411815939: Hey, you got the bad guy. That’s all there is to it.
lines.369680624411815940: Don't beat yourself up, it’s not doing you any good.
lines.369680624416010240: Just get in your car and head back home. You've earned some rest.
lines.369680624416010241: Sunshine, palm trees and an endless blue ocean.
